title: Two clubs' standings rows moved between the frozen read and this one
detail: WAS and NYG both changed. The deltas imply exactly one result, WAS 24 - NYG 21, and the league points identity still balances at 6,291. Nothing was back-filled into the frozen snapshot.

title: The standings table prints columns it does not name
detail: Three 3-part records and two decimals render without a header. The page legend names HOME, ROAD, DIV and CONF but the rendered order does not identify which is which, so they are withheld rather than guessed.

title: Chicago's printed chart is dated before the injury ledger it is joined to
detail: The Bears print 'Depth Chart (As of 10/31/2026)'. The injury ledger is Week 10. The chart date is published on every CHI row rather than assumed current.

title: Philadelphia's chart contradicts the club's own news feed
detail: The chart lists Hollywood Brown and Fred Johnson, while the same page's headline list reports both waived on 2026-11-13. The chart is also self-labelled 'UNOFFICIAL' by the club.

title: Philadelphia prints a depth slot with no first-string name
detail: One DT row prints an empty first cell and Ty Robinson as second string. The slot is kept with the gap preserved and counted, not filled.

title: Houston publishes no readable depth chart on two independent reads
detail: The page renders a heading and an image with no table. Houston's 16 injury rows keep a blank rank and a blank replacement.

title: Only 4 of 28 clubs publish a game status
detail: 301 of 326 injury rows carry a blank game status. This desk cannot say who is actually unavailable for 24 clubs, which caps every availability conclusion.

title: The Pythagorean residuals are less dispersed than chance
detail: The overdispersion statistic is 19.03 on 32 df (p=0.966), a variance inflation of 0.59. That is not evidence of skill; it is a caution against reading a leaderboard into 8-9 game records.

title: A correlation with r=0.87 is a validity check, not a finding
detail: Pythagorean expected wins correlate with actual wins at r=0.867 by construction, because both sides come from the same PF/PA pair. It is published as a method check and must not be read as a tradable signal.

title: No price, no ROI and no CLV exists anywhere in this desk
detail: NFL.com publishes no odds and the rights question is unsettled, so market, ROI, CLV, stake and reward fields are blank by rule and are asserted blank by a test.

title: The four clubs with no chart were the Week 10 bye clubs
detail: This explains the earlier gap: a bye club has no Week 10 injury row, so the missing charts never showed up as unmatched injury rows. The charts are now captured and are ready for Week 11.

title: Some players are printed in more than one depth slot
detail: 24 of 265 matched injury rows are players their own club prints in more than one slot, and 1 of the 8 ruled-out starters is one of them. The join uses one printed slot per player (the most prominent) and marks every affected row, so the named replacement is correct for that slot but could differ in another slot the club also lists him in.

title: The depletion index weights are a project choice, not a measurement
detail: Rank weights (1.00 / 0.45 / 0.20 / 0.10) and status multipliers order clubs against each other. They are disclosed on the page and are never converted to points, probability or price.
